messages:
talia: Heads up — we've got a tricky one. Customers report that when we route requests through the regional proxy, the project attribution flips to the proxy's default project and eats into unrelated project quotas. Not good.
ben: That sounds like the proxy is rewriting the origin header or not forwarding X-Redwood-Project. We intentionally fallback to proxy-owner project if no project claim found to avoid orphaned traffic, but this is noisy.
miguel: Can you paste an example header chain from a failing request?
talia: example: `Authorization: Bearer sk-prod_zzz`, `X-Forwarded-For: 10.2.3.4`, `X-Redwood-Project: ` (missing), proxy added `X-Proxy-Owner: proj-infra-11` and routing set billing_project=proj-infra-11
ruth: So current precedence: token_claim > X-Redwood-Project > X-Proxy-Owner > org_default. Proxy-owner was added to support internal tooling, but it should never override an explicit origin.
ben: We need two fixes: 1) routing precedence clarification (proxy-owner should be last) 2) telemetry to detect rewrites.
miguel: Telemetry idea: emit `routing.source_chain` list in traces and a boolean `proxy_injected_project`. We can dark-launch telemetry quickly.
talia: UX ask from support: add a console table filter for requests where `proxy_injected_project=true` and a bulk mapping flow to move those events to a chosen project.
ruth: Mapping flow must not change historical billing exports. It should only reassign future attribution. For past rows, finance can accept an adjustment API if needed.
ben: Implementation: change routing middleware to not accept X-Proxy-Owner unless `X-Redwood-Project` absent AND `X-Original-Project` absent. Also add FF `allow_proxy_owner_override` for a short canary.
miguel: I'll own telemetry and add trace attr. Plan: dark-run for 48h, measure prevalence, then enable FF for 2% orgs.
talia: Tests: unit tests for precedence, integ test simulating proxy chain with missing headers. Add integration test for billing exporter so BQ schema stays stable.
ruth: Product will add console filter and the mapping flow mock. Support wants copy: "Some requests were routed to your infra project due to missing project metadata. Map them to an existing project or update header forwarding."
ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-5120: "proxy-header attribution - routing precedence, telemetry, and console mapping" assigned to miguel/ben/ruth.
talia: Owners: ben -> routing middleware FF, miguel -> traces/metrics, ruth -> console mapping UX, talia -> support copy + rollout. Sync tomorrow 09:30 to review telemetry numbers.
ben: Also flag: ensure key-level rate-limits still apply even if billing attribution changes. We enforce key-id limits before attribution.
talia: Good catch. If anything else comes up about signed proxies or auth exchanges, drop here. Closing for now. :thumbsup:
